title: Jesus washes the disciples' feet
description: During the meal before Passover, Jesus rises, takes off his outer garment, ties a towel around himself and begins to wash the disciples' feet. Peter protests at first but yields when Jesus says that whoever is not washed by him has no part with him. Afterwards, Jesus explains that he has given them an example: just as he, their Lord and Teacher, has served them, so they should serve one another.

versions.title: Jesus washes the disciples' feet
versions.description: Jesus washes the disciples' feet as an example of serving love and humility.
versions.reason: [minor] references: The story of the foot washing actually extends to verse 20, where Jesus concludes his teaching on service. Verse 17 is a reasonable ending, but verses 1–20 could also be considered.; [major] duplicate: There is an existing story 'the-last-supper' that covers John 13:1–30 including the foot washing. However, the foot washing is a distinct narrative unit that can stand alone as its own story, so merging them may not be appropriate—rather, it should be delimited.
